chunks: And Hārūn ibn Khārijah narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام, whenever he intended to go out to some of his properties, would purchase safety from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, with whatever was available to him. That would be when he placed his foot in the stirrup. Then, if Allah, Mighty and Majestic, kept him safe and he returned, he would praise Allah, Exalted is He, thank Him, and give charity with whatever was available to him.

key_terms.الرِّكَابِ: the stirrup, indicating the moment of mounting for travel
key_terms.السَّلَامَةَ: safety and protection granted by Allah during travel
key_terms.بِمَا تَيَسَّرَ لَهُ: with whatever was readily available to him
key_terms.حَمِدَ: he praised Allah for His favor
key_terms.شَكَرَهُ: he thanked Allah in response to safe return

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام seek Allah’s protection before travel?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام when setting out for travel related to his property. He would begin with charity seeking safety from Allah and, upon safe return, respond with praise, gratitude, and further charity, showing reliance upon Allah and thankfulness for His protection.
